lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Hey, Juliet. Got ten minutes for Friday?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Yes. I've got the run order open right in front of me, actually.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Great. So, I open. Two minutes. Intros, what we're about to show, keep it light.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Then Romeo does the offline sync. Inspection in airplane mode, he reconnects, we watch it go.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: And then you do the PDF. Same inspection?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Same inspection. That's the whole story. He sees it made with no signal, and then he sees the signed report for it.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Love it. Oh, did Paris say anything about who's coming on his side?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: He did. Their auditor may join, for the PDF part.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Oh, good. Honestly, that's the person we most need to convince.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Yeah. So I want the PDF part really plain. Here's what it says, here's who signed, here's when.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Okay. One thing I'd add. At the end, before the questions run out, I think we ask about a pilot. Small. Two sites.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Two sites. Yeah. I had 'ask about a pilot' on the list, but not how big.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Two's enough to learn something, and small enough that nobody needs a committee. I'm happy to ask it, if that's okay. It's a nice way to close.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Please. You ask.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: And, um, if the sync doesn't cooperate on the day...

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: I wrote that down too. I think we record a video of the sync, just in case.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Let's record it Thursday, so it's the real build.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Thursday. I'll grab Romeo and we'll do it. And there's a spare tablet. And I'm testing the room's wifi Friday morning.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Which room?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: The big one. It's fine. Mostly. Unless someone's on a video call next door.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: So it's fine until we're on a video call.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: ...Yes.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Well, if it drops halfway through, that's very on-message for an offline demo.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Don't say that to Romeo, he'll want to do it on purpose.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Ha. Okay. So, me on the intro and the pilot ask, Romeo on the sync, you on the PDF. Will Mercutio's mock be ready?

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: He said Thursday.

lines.speaker: benvolio_montague
lines.text: Then I think we're in good shape. Thanks, Juliet.

lines.speaker: juliet_capulet
lines.text: Thanks, Benvolio. Talk Friday.
